_nota: W3-CT-CORPUS-B. Corpus vol. VI (GDD §6 D01, §15.1). Formato común (ver D01.SCAN y D01.SILV): p1 = escena inicial con la cabecera de la serie (XXII), p2 = escena central (abre con «[…]»: el Diógenes), ~300 palabras, tramos de una oración con q: y src_en exacto (tests/fixtures/canon/gree.txt), clip_entities [watson]. Contrato §4.8 (C7, grupo vinculo_mycroft): #pall_mall (C7.R6, con R:HC01.sobre: el matasellos de Pall Mall; enlaza por pall_mall), #whitehall (C7.R7, con L:wiggins.vieja_tarifa: «de Pall Mall a Whitehall»; enlaza por whitehall y pall_mall), #founders (C7.R4, con N:L2.cotter_canastilla y N:L2.cesto_tiras: «…GENES CLUB · PALL MALL…»; enlaza con el cesto por pall_mall, implícito: el club está en Pall Mall, como dicen #pall_mall y #carlton). La frase «Mycroft lodges in Pall Mall, and he walks round the corner into Whitehall…» se parte en dos oraciones para que cada ruta tenga su tramo; #pall_mall junta «lodges in Pall Mall» y «just opposite his rooms» (dos q:). Todo lo demás es ruido. chron_date (guardián): tarde de verano; después de «Estudio en escarlata» (nov. 1887), porque Mycroft llama al doctor cronista de su hermano.
title: «El intérprete griego», The Strand Magazine, septiembre de 1893

catalog.label: «El intérprete griego», The Strand Magazine, vol. VI (septiembre de 1893)

parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes XXII\. — El intérprete griego {{#parientes e:holmes q:parientes|En mi larga e íntima relación con el señor [[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]] nunca le había oído aludir a sus parientes, y casi nunca a sus primeros años.}} {{#huerfano e:holmes q:huerfano|Había llegado a creer que era huérfano y que no le quedaba ningún pariente vivo, pero un día, con gran sorpresa mía, empezó a hablarme de su hermano.}} \[…\] {{#arte e:holmes q:arte|—El arte en la sangre suele tomar las formas más extrañas.}} —Pero ¿cómo sabe usted que es hereditario? {{#hermano e:mycroft q:hermano|—Porque mi hermano [[mycroft|Mycroft]] lo posee en mayor grado que yo.}} —¿Es menor que usted? {{#mayor e:mycroft q:mayor|—Siete años mayor.}} \[…\] {{#club e:mycroft q:club|—[[club_diogenes|El club Diógenes]] es el club más raro de Londres, y Mycroft uno de los hombres más raros.}} {{#horario e:mycroft q:horario|Está allí siempre de las cinco menos cuarto a las ocho menos veinte.}} \[…\] —{{#pall_mall a:vinculo_mycroft e:mycroft q:pall_mall q:enfrente|[[mycroft|Mycroft]] se aloja en [[pall_mall|Pall Mall]], justo enfrente del [[club_diogenes|club Diógenes]].}} {{#whitehall a:vinculo_mycroft e:mycroft e:pall_mall q:whitehall|Cada mañana dobla la esquina hasta [[whitehall|Whitehall]], y cada tarde vuelve.}} {{#ejercicio e:mycroft q:ejercicio|De un año a otro no hace ningún otro ejercicio, ni se lo ve en ninguna otra parte.}}

src_en.parientes: During my long and intimate acquaintance with Mr. Sherlock Holmes I had never heard him refer to his relations, and hardly ever to his own early life.
src_en.huerfano: I had come to believe that he was an orphan with no relatives living, but one day, to my very great surprise, he began to talk to me about his brother.
src_en.arte: Art in the blood is liable to take the strangest forms.
src_en.hermano: Because my brother Mycroft possesses it in a larger degree than I do.
src_en.club: The Diogenes Club is the queerest club in London, and Mycroft one of the queerest men.
src_en.horario: He’s always there from quarter to five to twenty to eight.
src_en.enfrente: except only in the Diogenes Club, which is just opposite his rooms.
src_en.whitehall: he walks round the corner into Whitehall every morning and back every evening.
src_en.ejercicio: From year’s end to year’s end he takes no other exercise, and is seen nowhere else
src_en.misantropia: There are many men in London, you know, who, some from shyness, some from misanthropy, have no wish for the company of their fellows.
src_en.insociables: It is for the convenience of these that the Diogenes Club was started, and it now contains the most unsociable and unclubable men in town.
src_en.founders: My brother was one of the founders
src_en.carlton: We had reached Pall Mall as we talked, and were walking down it from the St. James’s end.
src_en.forasteros: Holmes showed me into a small chamber which looked out into Pall Mall, and then, leaving me for a minute, he came back with a companion whom I knew could only be his brother.
src_en.corpulento: Mycroft Holmes was a much larger and stouter man than Sherlock.
src_en.foca: I am glad to meet you, sir,” said he, putting out a broad, fat hand like the flipper of a seal.
src_en.cronista: I hear of Sherlock everywhere since you became his chronicler.
src_en.soldado: An old soldier, I perceive,” said Sherlock.
src_en.licenciado: And very recently discharged,” remarked the brother.
